lines.text: Line two hundred thirty-nine, end, runs once when the command finishes or is interrupted.
If interrupted, or this leg stops at its goal, it stops the robot.
Line two hundred forty-one warns: Idle is not a stop. So line two hundred forty-two sends zero velocity.
A waypoint that finishes normally sends nothing, and keeps rolling at its corner speed.
The next command's initialize seeds commanded from that measured speed. A smooth hand-over.
Drive Then Align does this: through staging at speed, then Drive To Tag takes over.
The template's two-leg auto stops after each leg. Make its first leg pass through, and you get our ninety degree corner.
That's the whole file: four questions, one speed rule, two hundred forty-five lines.
